title: Mouse waving hello
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M30 78 Q12 82 10 68 Q9 58 18 60" fill="none" stroke="#e8899a" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#b8b8c8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="15" ry="13" fill="#d8d8e8"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="89" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#e8899a"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="89" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#e8899a"/>
  <!-- left arm resting -->
  <path d="M30 68 Q22 72 22 78" fill="none" stroke="#b8b8c8" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <path d="M70 66 Q80 58 82 46" fill="none" stroke="#b8b8c8" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- waving paw -->
  <circle cx="83" cy="43" r="7" fill="#e8899a"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="38" r="3" fill="#f5b0bf"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="38" r="3" fill="#f5b0bf"/>
  <circle cx="89" cy="43" r="3" fill="#f5b0bf"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="27" cy="38" r="14" fill="#b8b8c8"/>
  <circle cx="27" cy="38" r="8" fill="#e8899a"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="38" r="14" fill="#b8b8c8"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="38" r="8" fill="#e8899a"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="24" ry="22" fill="#c8c8d8"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="48" r="4.5" fill="#2a2030"/>
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="46.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="48" r="4.5" fill="#2a2030"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="46.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="59" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#e8899a"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M43 65 Q50 70 57 65" fill="none" stroke="#7a6a80" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1="34" y1="57" x2="22" y2="54" stroke="#9a9aaa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="61" x2="22" y2="63" stroke="#9a9aaa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="57" x2="78" y2="54" stroke="#9a9aaa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="61" x2="78" y2="63" stroke="#9a9aaa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="60" r="3.5" fill="#f5b0bf" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="60" r="3.5" fill="#f5b0bf" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
